items.proposed_content: Tensor, triple-product, and symmetric-power constructions combine unramified local parameters into new, generally higher-degree global L-functions. Their local definitions specify what data are combined, but do not automatically confer global analytic properties: the survey separately invokes Rankin-Selberg and Langlands-Shahidi methods, both dependent on Eisenstein-series analysis, and records continuation and functional equations only for the stated cases. Thus construction enlarges the object available for analysis while increasing degree and leaving case-specific continuation as a separate proof burden.
